title: Contract
description: Validates the content of a contract artifact. Every criterion carries exactly one content kind - behavior (execution-native) or meaning (reconstruction-native) - and an operational check stating actor, procedure, observable, and declared conforming and falsifying cases, per ADR-0010. The lens names the criterion's source and coverage; the kind selects the native check.

work_unit.description: Common envelope - threads to work unit.

criteria.description: Contract criteria: kind-typed, lens-sourced, operationally checked.

id.description: Stable criterion identifier used by completion evidence.

lens.description: Source and coverage lens for this criterion - where it comes from and what the change must cover, such as behavior, documentation, or code-quality. A lens never determines how the criterion is checked.

acceptance_criterion.description: Source for this contract criterion: numbered work-unit acceptance criterion or explicit body-ground obligation.

statement.description: Concrete definition of done for this criterion.

hollow_delivery.description: A delivery that would appear plausible but fail this criterion.

kind.description: Content kind - the closed two-kind set ADR-0010 ratifies. behavior: what the artifact does, natively checked by execution. meaning: the argument or distinction the artifact transmits, natively checked by reconstruction against a stated proposition. The set grows only by ADR.

check.description: The check as an operational procedure - contract content, independent of where the check runs.

actor.description: Who or what performs the check: the system under test, an instantiated cold recipient, or a fitness function.

conforming_case.description: A concrete input or delivery that passes the check.

falsifying_case.description: A concrete input or delivery that fails the check.
